reason: I don't swallow pills, and this is two capsules a day. My doctor said my magnesium could be low, but I'd look for a gummy or a drink mix, not capsules.
objection: Two capsules every day when I hate swallowing pills, and only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule. I can't tell why this one is worth $30.
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or powder version I could take without swallowing anything.
